required_revisions.item: R1 (coverage under-recording, same class as round-4 (a)/(b)): skill_md_validation_scripts only lists the scripts in SKILL.md's '## Validation' section (gate_sweep.py: split('## Validation')). SKILL.md's 'Canonical active path' block (lines 246/248) gives `python scripts/validate_core_execution_bundle.py` and `python scripts/validate_core_score_admission.py` as commands. Neither appears in any trace (argv grep: 0 runs), and neither is in skill_md_validation_scripts.not_executed. They show up only in path_arg_validators_summary.not_run. Either list every SKILL.md command (36 distinct script names by grep, against 26 'listed') or state the section scope in the record's note. Also run, or explicitly record as not run, the two canonical-path validators against the active_core_gate PASS.

R2 (mutation case cannot isolate its check): sycophancy_threshold_self_declared sets {'score':4,'threshold':99}. score 4 already fails the 0<=score<3 check, so the case stays blocked even with the threshold==3 check removed (canary-cases.json: actual ['anti-sycophancy threshold failed'], exact_match true in the canary). Change it to an in-range score with a wrong threshold, e.g. {'score':1,'threshold':5}. Today only sycophancy_threshold_missing isolates the threshold check.

R3: the in-package runner counts a case as blocked on any error (cases.append((name,bool(errs),errs))). Message-specific isolation exists only in the out-of-package probe_mutation_cases.py. Move the expected-message check into run_release_gate_mutation_evals.py, so that a case blocked only by an unrelated error fails inside the package.

R4 (provenance labelling for (c)): round 4 reviewed build 4ab90a9 (commit 2026-10-29 04:01). The A3 owner-clarification row was added in 5305049 (2026-10-29 10:58), and its own text says 'Review round 4 reported A3 AMBIGUOUS'. So owner_resolved=['A3'] in round 4 is a later owner adjudication, written by the generator, not a reviewer outcome. The binding_note and yardstick_note disclose this. Store the owner adjudication in its own record, separate from the independent-review round, so that 'latest independent review passed every probe' is not partly an owner decision.

R5 (residual, disclosed): CUSTOMER_REPORT_RELEASE PASS rests on a recorded data_class label plus 'audit hash not a tree file' and 'PDF not a proof PDF'. A one-byte-modified example input would pass both hash checks. The docstring admits this, and only the customer-mode build refusal guards against it. Keep it documented; consider binding PASS to a signed customer-mode build receipt.
